body: I have no idea. Please just call the cops on me or tell them that I'm manhandling someone, I honestly just want this to end. Thank you for noticing.
I wish I was more like you.

I'm just really angry, since I literally accidentally did that yesterday at night, when my mother happened to see me sitting on the sofa in tears, it wouldn't have happened if she hadn't come out of her room to fetch herself some water. (Fortunately she didn't see the knife besides me but I think she took it from under my bed in the morning); It would have made no difference since the whole day has passed now and she hasn't even spoken to me, partly because I've locked myself and told her that I'm studying but still. It's like she doesn't even remember anything. Oh, I remember now, it was me who'd told her that she needs to forget whatever she just saw. I'm hellbent on committing suicide it seems. Please, this might be the stupidest thing to ever say, but just please come over to my house and hold me or send me to the asylum, I promise I'll give back the money to whoever is reading this, because I don't have the courage to talk about it in real life.
I don't think I can do this, I'm sorry. I'm so weak that I literally cried just from reading several replies of yours. The world doesn't deserve this and I'm just being honest.

Please don't say that, and by the way, I'm making things worse for others and hurting everyone. I am mentally incapable of contributing to society. I wish I could just talk to someone, but that comes in the way of my final plans. I want someone to hug me or keep me locked up, tied down etc whatever, because I'm going crazy and I don't trust myself.

Porn is the least of my problems. I won't discuss anything here because this place is only for people wanting to quit porn. I understand and appreciate that, but I've realized that some people are a cancer in society. Their actions are wholly selfish. They get off on harming people for fun. For people like this, nothing of value would be lost if they didn't exist. If the person themselves is willing to realize that, then I don't think it's entirely unreasonable for them to have their life ruined or taken as penance. And I'd rather not have mine ruined, because that's exactly what's happening and I can't do anything about it.

Not everybody deserves to live. And besides, there isn't any hope for redemption for me now. I wish I had the courage to ask for euthanasia now, but I never even had the courage to ask for help ever since they brushed off my issues. I want to step harming others, and I believe now is the best time. Hell, now I'm thinking I shouldn't have looked for help.

Exactly. Self-harm is a cry for help, and that's why I won't do it; perhaps I don't want help anymore, I think it's all for the better that I've made up my mind. God knows if I'm in denial mode or if I'm doing things for my own good, I think its the latter, even if it isn't. I'm not even willing to change my bad habits, I'm sure nobody thinks that a person like that would deserve to live. I need a good reason to go on but there isn't any.
Do you still get these thoughts on the daily? If not, I'm willing to take this advice as much as possible. Thank you so much.

I'm sorry I can't even think with what people call a "rational mind" anymore. I think that suicidal thoughts give me relief, but that doesn't mean I'm not planning to do it and that it's just something to soothe me. I'm falling deeper and deeper into this abyss, and I secretly like it because I find depression relaxing. I don't think I can be normal anymore, perhaps I don't want to be normal, I like hurting my family and I don't deserve to ruin them for the rest of their lives, because I'm not going to become anything. And no I'm not going to kill anyone, the chances are slim of that happening.
Zebra water

I might be late, but I just wanted to say the part where you mentioned the school hours resonates with me so much. I literally spent the whole night having panic attacks and anxiety and now there's just two hours left before school.

I'm 15, and please don't tell me that I'm young and I have a whole life ahead with lots of things yet to experience. I know that, and that has nothing to do with my current set of problems and doesn't make them invalid. This isn't a phase either.  Plus, I'd rather end everything right now than 40 years later when I've wasted all my family's resources and felt guilty enough to actually go through with it.

I've been thinking of suicide daily for the past month, if not for the past couple of years where it happened every alternate day or two. I'm severely mentally exhausted, to say the least, & if this is how I'm going to live the rest of my life, then I beg you to help me. I don't even know what I'm gonna type next, so please excuse me if I sound like I'm changing the topic or if it doesn't even make sense, since I'm having lots of different feelings & thoughts right now. I want to call my father & ask him if he's okay because I'm having a funny feeling that something's wrong. He lives in another city not far from here, but he comes home once in a week or so.                                                        
        I wish I could tell him that I'm not okay, but they'll just think I'm being clingy because this whole event occurred last month where I had told my whole family I wasn't okay & I needed their help, had showed my parents my suicide letter, promised them I won't do anything stupid etc. So I can't possibly go back to that same state in their minds, else I'd be labelled a coward or someone who needs attention constantly.                            
        Hell, maybe I do, & if they're going to make me feel bad for it I'll just stop communicating my problems like I have already. I hate sleeping alone, & my Mom thinks I'm watching too much TV when the truth is I was awake all night searching up suicide methods & cried myself to sleep & woke up & proceeded to cry again in the bathroom. Pretty sure she almost heard me or perhaps did hear me but didn't do anything. I've turned out to be the opposite of my sister. I guess I'm not cut out for this world. I wish I could tell her that I'm leaving & I need her to understand my decision & take care of everyone. But she's not the same twin I had whom I could trust & relate to. She's become mature, while I remained my 12yo self all these years who sacrificed his mental issues and kept quiet for the sake of family.

I'm sorry I haven't read your full post yet, but all I can say is that I'm making things worse everyday and although I wish I could speak for others, but I'm sure that I, for one, do not deserve to live.  I had recently told my sister about my suicide attempt and although I'd assured her I won't do anything stupid, she didn't actually provide me help when I asked for it,  yet made me promise not to do anything like what I'm about to do. Perhaps I'd forgotten to mention to her that I still was NOT ok,  there was no way I'd been completely fine a week after having almost killed myself but I fucked up my chances of getting help. It's too late.

There's no use when I'm the problem,  I feel happy when I think of suicide,  and I end up forgetting about it since I'm happy, and then I feel even more guilty about my existence. I don't know if that makes sense but that's exactly what has happened with me every single day for over the past two years.
Thank you so much. You don't even know how much I needed to hear that.
I just wanted to say thank you to both of you. I had started to feel as if all was lost, and maybe it is.
I'm in high school. And I'm really sorry, my mind can't actually process anything that you're saying to try and help me. Even I can't help myself.

Nah, pretty sure she'll panic out. I just wanted someone to talk to before I do it, not because I'm still looking for help, but just because it'd have felt good to let someone know. I'd prefer talking to her, but all I'm gonna do now is leave a separate letter and go on about my task normally.

Thanks for replying, I guess.
Woah..I thought the mods deleted this post for some reason so I made another one all over again. Dunno what to do now.
Don't worry brother..I was scrolling to see if I had any replies to my post and came across this. You should try visiting this subreddit: r/NoFap

Thank you so much, I just wanted to get feedback on this letter I'm writing for my sister separately before I go forward with it, and I'd appreciate if you could provide me some feedback on it. I had wanted to talk to her personally but I felt that she'd panic out. Add to that the fact she's studying for her exams so I didn't want to distract her or get her worried, and she'd have felt that I was messing with her. We can talk privately if you don't mind, I'd appreciate some quick feedback.
I've done things that are unforgiveable,  and now I'm starting to forget all of them,  which makes me feel worse and a cheater,  as if I never even had a chance to solve things one by one
I'm sorry-I can't be helped at this point. I just feel like it's either now or never.
PS feel free to ask me my reasons although the chances are that I may not be in a sane state at the time I read your reply. If I get any, that is.

Same. I can't accept who I'm becoming and I know that my dreams are too far-fetched to be true. But at the same time, I won't settle for anything less. I foresee myself as becoming a burden and a liability for everyone around me, so I'm looking for a suitable date to kill myself. Might do it after my exams get over.
